concept: Redshift Serverless: pay only while queries run
tests: How to avoid paying for an idle Redshift cluster with occasional quarterly reporting.
expected: Amazon Redshift Serverless — auto-provisioning and scaling, billed (RPU-hours) only while queries run. Triggers: "few days per quarter", "mostly idle", "avoid paying for idle provisioned capacity".
why_not: An always-on provisioned cluster and Reserved Nodes pay for idle time; RDS can't handle analytics at this scale.
